not_covered.topic: War on drugs, Illegal drug trade in Latin America, Crime in Spain
not_covered.text: The Spanish Civil Guard and the Ecuadorian National Police announce they have arrested 44 people and confiscated 21 tons of cocaine as part of a multiyear investigation on a drug trafficking ring financed by investors in Dubai.

not_covered.topic: Pastoral trips made by Pope Leo XIV
not_covered.text: The Holy See Press Office announces Pope Leo XIV will make a apostolic journey to Argentina, Uruguay, and Peru, in November, marking his first trip to Latin America in his papacy.
